sections.heading: Welcome aboard Britannia
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide. This app is not affiliated with P&O Cruises. Information is for planning only; follow onboard announcements and crew instructions.

sections.heading: Official ship information
sections.body:
P&O Cruises Britannia ship overview (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/britannia/overview
Use the deck plans accessible from the official ship information to confirm cabin, lift, venue and muster locations. Check the current official plan for your sailing.

sections.heading: Finding your way
sections.body: Save your cabin number, deck and muster point in Ship & Cabin. The Deck Guide is a personal orientation tool, not a substitute for an official deck plan. Venue deck assignments in this first release are intentionally marked for verification.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Britannia dining includes main restaurants Meridian, Peninsular and Oriental, casual dining at Horizon, and speciality venues such as Sindhu, The Glass House and The Epicurean. Check the current ship programme for availability, reservations and charges.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Britannia offers theatre shows, live music and entertainment spaces including Headliners Theatre, The Live Lounge and The Limelight Club. Performances and reservations can vary by voyage.

sections.heading: Before sailing
sections.body: Check your passport and travel documents, boarding time, insurance and luggage requirements. Download or open the app while online before relying on its offline features.

sections.heading: Sea days and ports
sections.body: Use My Cruise to enter your own port calls, excursions and return reminders. These are personal notes only and do not replace the ship’s official all-aboard times.

sections.heading: App information and updates
sections.body: Your planner, packing list and spending records are stored locally on this device. Use Settings to export a backup before clearing browser data. Information updates and adverts are published separately by the app owner and may require an internet connection.

sections.heading: Dining reservations and charges
sections.body: Main dining arrangements may be assigned or flexible depending on your booking. Speciality restaurants and some experiences may require reservations and additional payment. Check the P&O Cruises app or onboard staff for the latest availability, menus, opening times and prices.

sections.heading: Shows and evening entertainment
sections.body: Check the daily onboard programme for Headliners Theatre performances, live music, guest acts and activities. Some experiences may require booking. Add your plans to My Cruise and allow time to reach the venue.

sections.heading: Cabin and deck navigation
sections.body: Save your cabin number and deck in Ship & Cabin. For lifts, stairs, accessible routes and cabin locations use the official Britannia deck plan. Never rely on this unofficial guide for emergency routes or muster instructions.

sections.heading: Going ashore safely
sections.body: Record your port and excursion plans, but always use the ship’s official all-aboard time and local-time instructions. Carry any required travel documents and follow crew guidance. Your personal reminders in this app are not official notifications.

sections.heading: Offline use and backups
sections.body: Open the app while connected before sailing. Your planner and checklist are stored on this device; they are not automatically shared across devices. Download a backup from Settings before changing phones or clearing browser data. External P&O links require internet access.
